name: Eversource Massachusetts Discount Program (discount rate)
description: Discount on Eversource electric or gas bills for customers who receive a qualifying public assistance benefit or meet household income requirements. Discounts as of Nov. 1, 2026 range from 22% to 92% depending on income, household size and heating type.
contact: Call 211 or visit https://www.masscap.org/agencies/ to find your local Community Action Agency (income-based applications)

requirements.text: Must be an Eversource electric or gas customer. (Eversource is listed as the electric company for Amherst by UMass Amherst.)

Qualify by receiving a public assistance benefit (e.g. HEAP/Fuel Assistance, SNAP, MassHealth Basic or Standard, TAFDC, EAEDC, WIC, Head Start, public or subsidized housing, SSP, Veterans' Chapter 115 benefits) OR by meeting household income requirements.

Annual household income for all adults 18+ (combined gross income of all persons in the household) must be at or below 60% of State Median Income. Benefit recipients may qualify without meeting this test. Households receiving a qualifying public benefit can also qualify; see the provider page. Dollar amounts by household size: the 2026-2027 60% of State Median Income figures published by the Massachusetts Good Neighbor Energy Fund (see its income floor).

unknowns: The income table columns are not labelled on the page; the encoded limits are the highest (60% SMI) column
Whether the income test applies to someone who qualifies through a public assistance benefit (page presents them as alternatives)
Eversource phone number for this program (not shown on the page)
Whether the account must be in the applicant's name / primary residence (not stated on the page)
Amherst coverage confirmed only via a UMass Amherst page, not an Eversource service-territory page
Service area set to Amherst ZIP codes, the only area where Eversource service was confirmed from a fetched page.

guide.what: A 22% to 92% discount on your Eversource electric or gas bill, depending on income, household size and heating type.
guide.decided_by: Eversource. Income-based applications go through your local Community Action Agency

ways.title: Apply online
ways.detail: Use Eversource's discount rate form. Best if you get a benefit like SNAP, Fuel Assistance, MassHealth or WIC.

ways.title: Qualify by income
ways.detail: Call 211, or find your Community Action Agency at masscap.org/agencies.

guide.no_documents_note: Eversource doesn't list documents for this form. Have a recent bill handy for your account number.

first_step.title: Sign up for the Eversource discount rate
first_step.detail: Apply online with Eversource. A benefit like Fuel Assistance or SNAP can qualify you.
